recipes.title: Simple Pancakes
recipes.steps: Whisk flour, milk, and egg into a pourable batter. Cook small rounds in a warm pan until the surface sets, then flip. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Blood-Orange Pantry Stew
recipes.steps: Soften onion + garlic in oil. Add tomatoes, drained chickpeas, cumin, salt. Simmer 15 min. Squeeze in orange juice; zest on top.

recipes.title: Cain's Toast Hash
recipes.steps: Dice stale bread and potato; crisp in butter with onion. Push aside, scramble eggs in, fold together. Heavy pepper.

recipes.title: Jarred Pepper Pasta
recipes.steps: Boil pasta. Warm peppers + garlic + oil + chili. Toss with pasta water. Cheese if you have it.

recipes.title: Almost-Empty Fridge Frittata
recipes.steps: Sauté onion + greens. Whisk eggs + milk + salt, pour in, add cheese. Oven or lid until set.

recipes.title: Bean & Rice Survival Bowl
recipes.steps: Cook rice. Warm beans with onion + cumin. Plate rice, beans, acid + hot sauce.

recipes.title: Weeknight Broth Noodles
recipes.steps: Simmer broth + garlic + soy. Cook noodles in it. Soft-boil or drop in egg. Scallions + sesame if present.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Root Roast
recipes.steps: Chunk veg, toss with oil + spices, roast hot until edges char. Eat as-is or over rice.

recipes.title: Pantry Tuna Melt Cups
recipes.steps: Mix tuna + mayo + pickle + pepper. Pile on bread, top cheese, broil until bubbling.

recipes.title: Lentil Bolognese
recipes.steps: Soften onion + garlic. Add lentils + tomatoes + oregano; simmer until thick. Serve over pasta.

recipes.title: Midnight Chickpea Mash
recipes.steps: Mash chickpeas with oil, acid, grated garlic, salt. Dust paprika. Scoop with bread.
